criteria.name: npm run verify passes
criteria.evidence: No failures reported in provided code; tests not explicitly redacted but assumed implemented per stage history.

criteria.name: kernel.test.cjs passes including contract assertions
criteria.evidence: Model equations and assertions in model.ts align with stage card closed-form requirements (e.g., two-particle equilibrium math at line 96-101).

criteria.name: Browser smoke shows legible swarm (not 1px specks)
criteria.evidence: Rasterise() in kernel.ts splat code (lines 396-434) deposits 2px Gaussians but no contrast correction to ensure dark background. The colormap.ts addition (case 'swarmalators') reuses the phase ramp but does not address the GLSL shader issue that trapped zero-density cells at mid-blue instead of black (as documented in stage card's round-2 'findings' section). The fix requires a GLSL cyclic two-channel branch, which is not present in deliverables.

criteria.name: Presets show canonical states visually
criteria.evidence: Same GLSL shader defect as above (criteria 3) causes phase visualization to lack contrast. Preset color differentiation is visible only with explicit manual colormap tuning, not captured in current deliverables.

criteria.name: Color uses existing cyclic phase ramp
criteria.evidence: colormap.ts case 'swarmalators' at line 262: returns { ...base, preset: 'phase' } (line 263), correctly reusing the existing infrastructure without new ramps (constraints met).

criteria.name: No out-of-scope files modified
criteria.evidence: git diff in scope shows changes only under src/sims/swarmalators/, registry.ts, presets.ts, and colormap.ts (deliverables 1-5). No test files nor GLSL shader edits.

additional_findings: The critical visual defect (mid-blue zero-density background) lies outside the deliverables list (the missing GLSL fix). This violates constraint #144 ('Do not modify the renderer') and contradicts the stage card's final handoff note stating the defect was fixed. The working tree meets all mathematical and structural criteria but fails to fully resolve the visual contract.
